limitations: This confirms normal entry and error presentation, not opening or saving a real workflow design.
No temporary workflow, directory, file, permission or server mutation was performed to hide the resource-lifecycle gap.
The browser rendered the error; raw HTTP responses and mutation request counts were not independently captured.
Draft preservation, late-callback rejection and unknown-result recovery were exercised through real DataViews in isolated HTTP/file fixtures, not injected into a live business workflow.
The complete 20-package migration and S4 acceptance remain open.
